snippet.title: Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars | A Look Inside the Hail Mary
snippet.description:
The Hail Mary is coming into view.

See how the iconic ship takes shape in Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars, bringing familiar details from the film into an immersive mixed reality experience.

Pre-order now!

Models and environments shown are still in development and subject to change.
#ProjectHailMary #MixedReality #JourneyAmongtheStars
